simple.meaning: שַׁרְשְׁרָה (sharshᵉrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a chain ; (architectural) probably a garland.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שַׁרְשְׁרָה (H8333) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 28:14, with occurrences in Exodus, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שַׁרְשְׁרָה (H8333) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שַׁרְשְׁרָה (H8333) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שַׁרְשְׁרָה (sharshᵉrâh) / H8333 is traced through Exodus 28:14, Exodus 39:15, 1 Kings 7:17, 2 Chronicles 3:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
